title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
title_zh: CoworkOS：面向真实世界自动化的智能体协作者规模化

paragraphs.en: CoworkOS提出任务策略与执行管理分离的通用框架，支持长周期人机协作与真实世界自动化。 Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: CoworkOS 提出了任务策略与执行管理分离的通用框架，支持长周期人机协作与真实世界自动化。协作智能体（cowork agents）的快速进展正在将人机协作推向真实世界自动化，交付软件、设计稿及其他成果物。 然而，此类生产力工作既要求在复杂生产力任务上高质量交付，又要求在长周期内持续进行监督与决策，这种组合仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。 我们提出 CoworkOS，一个面向长周期工作的通用运行框架，它将任务策略与执行管理分离：由模型决定行动、委派与验收，而运行时负责维护状态与反馈。 其三层架构支持在职责稳定的前提下，同步或异步地直接执行或委派给子智能体（Subagents）。 通过共享的应用层，人类与智能体可以查看并修改同样处于演进中的文档、演示文稿、CAD 模型和 Blender 场景，因此人类在环的参与既可以经由对话进入，也可以通过对工作本身的直接修改进入。 为了在智能体与多个会话之间维持连续性，CoworkOS 进一步引入了分层工作区与持久化语义记忆，使工作文件、关键决策和长期运行的 Job 日志在中断后仍可共享、复用与恢复。 在 12 个基准和 6 类真实世界应用上，CoworkOS 与 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等前沿智能体应用相比展现出高度竞争力。 作为一个持续工作的案例研究，CoworkOS 以 GLM-5.3 为骨干模型，对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 开展了 RSI 驱动的自动化后训练。 经过五轮训练，该模型在八个基准上的平均得分从 33.19 提升至 42.95（+9.76）。 展望未来，我们相信 CoworkOS 为通向通用协作智能体智能开辟了一条有意义的路径。
